LanguageData.Bison.label: bisotope
LanguageData.Bison.description: A hulking, isotope-soaked descendant of the Old World bison. Generations of radiation have thickened its hide, warped its horns, and made entire herds dangerously territorial. Tamed bisotopes remain valuable pack animals and wool producers.
LanguageData.WildBoar.label: radhog
LanguageData.WildBoar.description: A mutated descendant of feral pigs, the radhog roots through ruins and poisoned soil for anything edible. Its coarse hide and radioactive bulk make it stubborn, aggressive, and much harder to bring down than its Old World ancestor.
LanguageData.Muffalo.label: pack rat
LanguageData.Muffalo.description: A giant strain of mole rat domesticated throughout the wasteland as a tireless beast of burden. Its broad back can support an improbable stack of salvaged packs, while generations of caravan breeding have made it hardy, docile, and comfortable in almost any climate. Pack rats no longer form wild populations; they are raised and traded wherever caravans travel.
LanguageData.WoolMuffalo.label: pack rat fur
LanguageData.WoolMuffalo.description: Dense, soft fur shorn from a pack rat. It provides excellent insulation against the cold without weighing down the wearer.
LanguageData.Leather_Bluefur.label: pack rat hide
LanguageData.Leather_Bluefur.description: The thick, furry hide of a pack rat. Generations spent hauling caravans through hostile climates have left it exceptionally good at regulating temperature.
LanguageData.Cobra.label: cottonmouth
LanguageData.Cobra.description: A heavy-bodied semiaquatic pit viper descended from escaped Old World snakes. Cottonmouths haunt flooded ruins and stagnant waterways, where their pale open jaws are often the last warning before a fast, venomous strike.
LanguageData.EggCobraFertilized.label: cottonmouth egg (fert.)
LanguageData.EggCobraFertilized.description: A fertilized cottonmouth egg. If kept warm, it will hatch into a young cottonmouth.
LanguageData.EggCobraUnfertilized.label: cottonmouth egg (unfert.)
LanguageData.EggCobraUnfertilized.description: An unfertilized cottonmouth egg. It can be eaten raw, but is safer cooked.
